newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: PAKISTAN STOCKS RECOUP, RISE AT MID-SESSION.
newsitem.headline: PAKISTAN STOCKS RECOUP, RISE AT MID-SESSION.

text.p: Leading Pakistani stocks recouped to trade higher at mid-session on fresh buying on Wednesday's new accounts day, dealers said.
The Karachi 100-share index rose 10.94 points, or 0.57 percent, to 1,940.75, after falling to 1,922.34 in early trade. Losers led gainers 112 to 43 at 12.01 p.m. (0701 GMT).
Buying by short-term investors buying lifted the index, one dealer said.
Pakistan telecom, which fell early on, rose 0.45 rupee to 42.45. Karachi Electric rose 2.50 rupees to 32. -- Ibrahim Khan (9221) 5685192; Fax (9221) 5673428
